title: RPEN shared shader library v1
description: Local editor preferences, not chart data. Runtime additionally validates GLSL 1.00, unique IDs/names, uniform defaults, UTF-8 byte limits and GPU compilation before interactive save. Applying a template creates a chart-local GLSL snapshot; later library edits never mutate existing chart copies. Optional source-comment metadata is described in $defs.chartSourceMetadata.

chartSourceMetadata.description: JSON in the optional // @rpen-template comment after #version. Ignored by GLSL consumers; not part of the chart event format. Unknown fields are preserved on source edits.
